name: georgeharker
description: Personal Claude Code plugins wrapping ruff, python-lsp-server (with pylsp-mypy), and shuck — LSP entries plus `/*-fix` commands, with opt-in PostToolUse hooks.

plugins.name: ruff-fix
plugins.description: `/ruff-fix` command (ruff check --fix + format on changed/named files) plus an opt-in autofix/diagnostics-on-edit hook. No LSP — composes with ruff-lsp or pylsp.

plugins.name: ruff-lsp
plugins.description: Registers `ruff server` as the Python LSP. Mutually exclusive with the `pylsp` plugin.

plugins.name: pylsp
plugins.description: Registers python-lsp-server + pylsp-mypy as the Python LSP; opt-in mypy-on-edit fallback hook. Mutually exclusive with the `ruff-lsp` plugin.

plugins.name: shuck
plugins.description: Registers `shuck server` as the shell LSP, plus a `/shuck-fix` command and an opt-in autofix/diagnostics-on-edit hook.
